title: Variance Fingerprints: Component-Wise Identification of Content Factors by Augmentation Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.14260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Augmentation-based self-supervised learning can recover the content shared across views without separating its underlying factors into individual coordinates. We ask whether augmentations can be designed to make those factors identifiable. Our approach allows content factors to fluctuate across augmented views while preserving their mean for each source instance. Each instance receives a fixed, recorded set of augmentation strengths that controls how much its factors fluctuate. When factors respond differently to changes in these strengths, their patterns of variation provide information that distinguishes them. Under suitable decoder and support assumptions, we prove that these differences identify individual factors in a conditional Gaussian model, up to permutation, scaling, and translation. We then develop a learner that uses the recorded strengths to estimate these patterns jointly across instances, enabling learning from few view

translated_title: 方差指纹：通过增广设计实现内容因子的逐分量辨识
translated_abstract: 基于增广的自监督学习能够恢复跨视图共享的内容，但无法将其潜在因子分离为独立的坐标分量。我们探讨是否可以通过设计增广方式使这些因子变得可辨识。我们的方法允许内容因子在增广视图之间发生波动，同时对每个源实例保持其均值不变。每个实例被赋予一个固定且被记录下来的增广强度集合，用于控制其各因子的波动幅度。当不同因子对这些强度变化的响应各不相同时，它们的变化模式便提供了能够彼此区分的信息。在适当的解码器与支撑集假设下，我们证明在条件高斯模型中，这些差异可以在置换、缩放和平移的意义下辨识出各个单独的因子。随后，我们开发了一种学习器，利用被记录的强度跨实例联合估计这些变化模式，从而实现从少量视图中学习。
tldr: 该论文提出一种增广设计方法，通过为每个实例记录固定的增广强度集合，使内容因子产生可区分的方差“指纹”，并在理论上证明、在实践中实现内容因子在置换、缩放和平移意义下的逐分量辨识。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an augmentation design that assigns each instance a fixed, recorded set of augmentation strengths, inducing distinguishable variance "fingerprints" that provably identify individual content factors up to permutation, scaling, and translation, together with a learner that jointly estimates these patterns from few views.
